project: Wuxia Life P111 Merchant Martial Patron Endgame Design-First
description: Design-first contract stage for merchant_martial_patron endgame / final legacy — define 3 endgame variants (one per late-life branch), GO/NO-GO assessment, contract, and P112 validation shape. Docs-only; no runtime wiring.

userStories.title: Audit patron endgame prerequisites
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a prerequisite audit for the patron endgame stage so P111 starts from the real gating surfaces and not from assumptions.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize patron route flags, markers, events, expressions (P102-P110)
Document state differences across 3 late-life branches (stats, flags, identity, cost label, goal)
Identify what exists before endgame vs what can be reused
Compare with renown P80 and magnate P100 endgame precedents for patron-unique opportunities
Save docs/test-reports/p111-merchant-martial-patron-endgame-prerequisite-audit.md
Do not change runtime behavior in this story
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Prerequisite audit saved; docs-only; typecheck passes

userStories.title: Lock P111 scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract so P111 stays design-first and does not slip into partial implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Limit P111 to prerequisite audit, scope contract, direction design, endgame contract, validation shape, closure
Define allowed layers: documentation, contract, targeted proof planning
List forbidden expansions: runtime wiring, P102-P110 rewrite, magnate spine rewrite, multi-event arc, new UI
Define lightweight constraint: max 1 echo event + expression updates
Save docs/test-reports/p111-merchant-martial-patron-endgame-scope-contract.md
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Design endgame direction (GO/NO-GO assessment)
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a clear assessment of whether patron endgame is worth doing, and if so, what direction it takes.
acceptanceCriteria: Assess whether late-life already provides sufficient closure
If GO: define endgame core positioning (legacy echo vs natural closure)
If NO-GO: define stop point at late-life with rationale
Decide whether 3 late-life branches need distinct endgame variants or unified echo
Clarify endgame vs late-life essence (final coda, not more content)
Save design document
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Design three endgame branches (if GO)
userStories.description: As a designer, I want three distinct endgame branches keyed on late-life markers so patron endgame leverages the 3-branch structure.
acceptanceCriteria: Design covenant_bound late-life endgame: narrative + trigger + player experience
Design isolated_merchant late-life endgame: narrative + trigger + player experience
Design sustainable_covenant late-life endgame: narrative + trigger + player experience
Three branches meaningfully different (not reskinned)
Each branch preserves merchant-martial patron flavor
Recommend single auto echo with 3 variants vs choice event
If NO-GO mark skipped with rationale
Save design document
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Define patron endgame contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want an explicit endgame contract so P112 knows exactly what flags, gates, events, and player-facing meanings must be closed.
acceptanceCriteria: Define endgame checkpoint merchant_patron_endgame_echo_done, required flags, gate acceptance
Define endgame event structure (recommend auto with 3 variants keyed on late-life marker)
Define stat changes (if any), identity markers, expression differences per branch
Define at least 2 endgame-specific player-facing signals
Clarify endgame vs late-life vs magnate/renown endgame
Define age range (e.g. 60-65)
If NO-GO mark skipped with rationale
Save contract to docs/PRD/p111-merchant-martial-patron-endgame-contract.md
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Define P112 validation shape
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the P112 validation shape fixed in advance so playable endgame work is judged against explicit expectations.
acceptanceCriteria: Define targeted proof chain nodes (late-life to endgame to expression changes)
All 3 late-life branches must have core node verification
Define minimum regression coverage: P102-P110 patron, P100/P101 magnate, guard:sample-lines-baseline
Define closure criteria count and threshold (P110 12-criteria pattern)
No full lifetime exhaust required
If NO-GO mark skipped with rationale
Save validation shape document
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Produce P111 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report that locks the patron endgame design-first contract and hands off to P112 or stops at late-life.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p111-merchant-martial-patron-endgame-closure-report.md
Summarize audit, scope, branch design, contract, validation shape
State GO or NO-GO for P112 playable endgame with rationale
List deferred patron-expansion items
Zero runtime changes in P111 stage
Typecheck passes
